card.name: Linking words before disease abbreviations
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, with, and, or, include) right before a named disease or its abbreviation such as Huntington's disease, PD, PDD or CJD. Also the word cardiac in a list of heart conditions.

modes.label: Link word before a named disease
modes.description: A word like of, with, or, and, include sits just before a neurological disease name or abbreviation.

modes.label: Cardiac in a list of heart conditions
modes.description: The word cardiac follows coronary insufficiency in a caution about sympathomimetic amines.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a disease name or abbreviation beginning with D, H or P (such as Dem- or dementia-like starts) and away from other word starts.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a disease name like Huntington's or Parkinson's disease is about to appear.
